source_title: Nainital teen held for sharing child pornography on dark web - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Dehradun: A teenager was apprehended in Nainital by the Uttarakhand Special Task Force (STF) and state cyber cell on Thursday for allegedly sharing child sexual abuse material on the dark web in exchange for money.
